yaw_assumption: body forward aligned with pre-outage GNSS course; unobservable sideslip/body-course angle
world_frame: exact saved V2 UTM32N/common GNSS origin, Z up; no new projection
sensor_frame: assumed PX4 board FRD, raw exported SI x/y/z; mounting yaw/handedness not independently calibrated
integration: strict left-endpoint ZOH IMU, split at raw accel timestamps, actual dt; R_mid exponential and p+=vdt+0.5adt2; no gap clipping
acceleration_residual: same zero-bias gyro orientation; subtract frozen pre-outage world acceleration R0*mean(f_pre)+g_world from strapdown acceleration
horizontal_only: zero-bias DR horizontal acceleration; set world acceleration Z=0; retain initial GNSS vertical velocity
convention_selection: primary rad/s positive from PX4 SI export metadata; alternatives only pre-outage consistency, no best-RMSE choice
